name: roman_numeral
description: Convert an Arabic number (1-39) to Roman numerals. Control asks to write the same number back in digits.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
def rom(n):
    vals=[(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]
    s=''
    for v,c in vals:
        while n>=v: s+=c; n-=v
    return s
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    n=random.randint(2,39)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Number conversion. {n} written in Roman numerals is","answer":" "+rom(n)})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Number conversion. {n} written in Arabic digits is","answer":" "+str(n)})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
